CORE EXPLANATION

A closure is an anonymous function that can capture values from its environment; `Fn`, `FnMut`, and `FnOnce` describe how it captures and can be called. Iterator adapters such as `map`, `filter`, and `take` build lazy pipelines, while `collect` and `fold` consume results. Lazy work begins at a terminal operation, so measure memory and performance for large streams.
